translations.literal: Let officials of the fourth rank and above assemble at the central secretariat, take all articles and statutes, and deliberate to settle on one path; those that cannot be applied, the responsible office shall suspend and record.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the fourth rank and above shall gather at the central secretariat, review all statutes and articles, and agree on a single course; whatever cannot be applied, the responsible office shall mark it suspended.

sentences.zh: 新定之格，勿與舊制相連。

translations.literal: Newly fixed statutes shall not be joined with the old system.
translations.idiomatic: New statutes must not be linked to the old code.

sentences.zh: 務在約通，無致冗滯。

translations.literal: Let the aim be brevity and clarity, and do not produce redundancy and obstruction."
translations.idiomatic: Seek brevity and clarity; do not allow prolixity and blockage."

sentences.zh: 」己酉，以侍中、驃騎大將軍、儀同三司、清河王亶為司徒公。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Xuan, Prince of Qinghe, attendant-in-ordinary, general of agile cavalry, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, was made Duke of the State of the Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Xuan, prince of Qinghe, attendant-in-ordinary, general of agile cavalry, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, was made duke of the state of the grandee.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔曰：「頃西土年飢，百姓流徙，或身倚溝渠，或命懸道路，皆見棄草土，取厭烏鳶。

translations.literal: On gengxu day an edict said: "Recently in the western regions famine pressed year on year; common people drifted in displacement—some leaned their bodies in ditches and channels, others hung their lives upon the road. All were cast upon the soil and grass to satiate crows and kites.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict said, "Recently in the western regions famine pressed year after year; people drifted in displacement—some leaned their bodies in ditches and channels, others hung their lives upon the road. All were cast upon the soil and grass to feed crows and kites.

sentences.zh: 言念於此，有警夜寐。

translations.literal: When We think on this, it keeps Us from peaceful sleep.
translations.idiomatic: When We think on this, the thought keeps Us from rest at night.

sentences.zh: 掩骼之禮，誠所庶幾；

translations.literal: The rite of covering exposed bones—this We truly hope for;
translations.idiomatic: Covering exposed bones in proper rite—this We truly hope for;

sentences.zh: 行墐之義，冀亦可勉。

translations.literal: the duty of filling in embankments—this too We trust can be urged.
translations.idiomatic: repairing broken embankments is also something We may urge.

sentences.zh: 其諸有露屍，令所在埋覆。

translations.literal: Wherever there are corpses left exposed, let the locality bury and cover them.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever bodies lie exposed, the locality shall bury and cover them.

sentences.zh: 可宣告天下。

translations.literal: Let this be proclaimed throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed throughout the realm."

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，詔外內解嚴。

translations.literal: On yimao day an edict released strictures within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day an edict lifted martial law within and without.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥朔，帝於華林園納訟。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on guihai day: the emperor heard lawsuits at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the guihai new moon, the emperor heard lawsuits at the Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，蠕蠕、嚈噠、高麗、契丹、庫莫奚國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Rouran, Hephthalites, Goguryeo, Khitan, and Kumo Xi all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Rouran, the Hephthalites, Goguryeo, Khitan, and Kumo Xi all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太尉公、司州牧、南陽王寶炬坐事降為驃騎大將軍、開府，王如故，歸第，令羽林衞守。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Baoju, Duke of the State as grandee of Taiwei, regional inspector of Si, and Prince of Nanyang, was reduced for an offense to general of agile cavalry and commander with open office; his princely title remained; he returned to his residence; the Feathered Forest guard was ordered to hold him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Baoju, grandee of taiwei, regional inspector of Si, and prince of Nanyang, was reduced for an offense to general of agile cavalry and commander with open office; his princely title remained; he returned to his residence under Feathered Forest guard.

sentences.zh: 改諡武懷皇帝曰孝莊。

translations.literal: The posthumous title of Emperor Wuhuai was changed to Xiaozhuang.
translations.idiomatic: The posthumous title of Emperor Wuhuai was changed to Xiaozhuang (Filial and Solemn).

sentences.zh: 癸酉，蠕蠕、嚈噠國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Rouran and the Hephthalites sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Rouran and the Hephthalites sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔內外百司普汎六級。

translations.literal: On wuyin day an edict granted a general promotion of six ranks to all offices within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict granted a general promotion of six ranks to every office inside and outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 在京百僚加中興四級，義師將士並加軍汎六級，在鄴百官三級，河北同義之州兩級，河橋建義者加五級，關西二級。

translations.literal: Capital officials received an additional four ranks for the Restoration; righteous-army commanders and soldiers likewise received a general military promotion of six ranks; officials at Ye three ranks; the Hebei provinces that joined the righteous cause two ranks; those who raised the righteous cause at Hey Bridge five ranks; Guanxi two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials received an additional four ranks for the Restoration; righteous-army commanders and soldiers a general military promotion of six ranks; officials at Ye three ranks; the Hebei provinces that joined the righteous cause two ranks; those who raised the righteous cause at Hey Bridge five ranks; Guanxi two ranks.

sentences.zh: 諸受建明、普泰封爵、汎級、優特之階，悉追。

translations.literal: All who had received enfeoffment, general promotions, and privileged ranks under Jianming and Putai were entirely revoked.
translations.idiomatic: All enfeoffments, general promotions, and privileged ranks granted under Jianming and Putai were entirely revoked.

sentences.zh: 己卯，帝臨顯陽殿納訟。

translations.literal: On jimao day the emperor heard lawsuits at the Xianyang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the emperor heard lawsuits at the Xianyang Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，高麗、契丹、庫莫奚國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Goguryeo, Khitan, and Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Goguryeo, Khitan, and Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以前驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司斛斯椿還為前官。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Chun, former general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, was restored to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Chun, former general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, was restored to his former office.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「間者，凶權誕恣，法令變常，遂立夷貊輕賦，冀收天下之意，隨以箕斂之重，終納十倍之征，掩目捕雀，何能過此。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Recently violent power waxed wanton and laws and ordinances turned irregular; they then set light levies on barbarian and border peoples, hoping to win the realm's hearts—then followed heavy extortion, and in the end collected levies tenfold; to cover the eyes and catch sparrows—how could it surpass this?
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "Recently violent power waxed wanton and laws and ordinances turned irregular; they set light levies on barbarian and border peoples, hoping to win the realm's hearts—then followed heavy extortion, and in the end collected levies tenfold; to cover the eyes and catch sparrows—how could it surpass this?

sentences.zh: 朕屬念蒸黎，無忘寢食，加田桑始事，生業未滋，若頓依常格，或不周展。

translations.literal: We keep the masses in mind and cannot forget even in sleep and meals; moreover fields and mulberries are but beginning their work and livelihoods are not yet abundant—if We suddenly rely on the usual statutes, it may not fully reach.
translations.idiomatic: We keep the masses in mind and cannot forget even in sleep and meals; moreover fields and mulberries are but beginning their work and livelihoods are not yet abundant—if We suddenly rely on the usual statutes, it may not fully suffice.

sentences.zh: 今歲租調，且兩收一丐，來年復舊。

translations.literal: This year's land tax and corvée levy shall for now be collected at two parts and remitted one; next year restores the former practice."
translations.idiomatic: This year's land tax and corvée shall be collected at two parts with one remitted for now; next year the former practice returns."

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，以使持節、衞大將軍、儀同三司、尚書左僕射賈顯度為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Xian Du, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, bearer of the staff with full powers, guard-general, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Jia Xiandu, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, bearer of the staff with full powers, guard-general, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙未，詔曰：「頃永安馭運，載育皇儲，遂錫汎階，以申國慶。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on yiwei day an edict said: "Recently under Yong'an the chariot of fortune bore the imperial heir; thereupon general promotions of rank were bestowed to proclaim the state's rejoicing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yiwei day an edict said, "Recently under Yong'an the chariot of fortune bore the imperial heir; thereupon general promotions of rank were bestowed to proclaim the state's rejoicing.

sentences.zh: 近經普泰，便爾中追。

translations.literal: Soon after Putai they were abruptly revoked midway.
translations.idiomatic: After Putai they were suddenly revoked halfway through.

sentences.zh: 今罪人既殄，舊章斯復。

translations.literal: Now the guilty are destroyed and the old statutes restored.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the guilty are destroyed, the old statutes are restored.

sentences.zh: 宜述往旨，用卒前恩。

translations.literal: We should carry out the previous intent and complete the prior grace.
translations.idiomatic: We should carry out the earlier intent and fulfill the prior grace.

sentences.zh: 皇子汎二級，悉可還授。

translations.literal: The princes' two ranks of general promotion may all be returned and conferred anew.
translations.idiomatic: The princes' two ranks of general promotion may all be returned and granted again.

sentences.zh: 文穆廟汎，故宜停寢，若已受者，依例追之。

translations.literal: The general promotion for Emperor Wenmu's temple should properly cease; those already received shall be reclaimed according to precedent."
translations.idiomatic: General promotions for Emperor Wenmu's temple should cease; those already received shall be reclaimed by precedent."

sentences.zh: 」庚子，以驃騎大將軍、開府、南陽王寶炬為太尉公。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Baoju, general of agile cavalry and commander with open office, Prince of Nanyang, was made Duke of the State as grandee of Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Baoju, general of agile cavalry and commander with open office, prince of Nanyang, was made grandee of taiwei.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，齊獻武王率眾入自滏口，大都督厙狄干入自井陘，討尒朱兆。

translations.literal: On renyin day Gao Huan led his host in from Fukou and Grand Commander Kudie Gan in from Jingxing Pass to attack Erzhu Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Gao Huan led his host in from Fukou and Grand Commander Kudie Gan in from Jingxing Pass to attack Erzhu Zhao.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，齊獻武王以尒朱天光、尒朱度律送之京師，斬於都巿。

translations.literal: On yisi day Gao Huan sent Erzhu Tianguang and Erzhu Dulü to the capital; they were beheaded in the metropolitan market.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Gao Huan sent Erzhu Tianguang and Erzhu Dulü to the capital and they were beheaded in the metropolitan market.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以兼尚書左僕射、東南道大行臺樊子鵠為儀同三司。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Zihong, left vice director of the Masters of Writing and acting grand mobile office of the southeast route, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Fan Zihong, left vice director of the Masters of Writing and acting grand mobile office of the southeast route, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔侍中、驃騎將軍、左光祿大夫高隆之為使持節、驃騎大將軍、儀同三司、兼尚書左僕射、北道行臺，率步騎十萬趨太行，會齊獻武王。

translations.literal: On gengxu day an edict made Longzhi, attendant-in-ordinary, general of agile cavalry, grandee of the left halberd, bearer of the staff with full powers, general of agile cavalry, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, concurrent left vice director, and northern-route grand mobile office, to lead infantry and cavalry numbering one hundred thousand toward Mount Taihang and join Gao Huan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu an edict made Gao Longzhi, attendant-in-ordinary, general of agile cavalry, grandee of the left halberd, bearer of the staff with full powers, general of agile cavalry, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, concurrent left vice director, and northern-route grand mobile office, lead one hundred thousand infantry and cavalry toward Mount Taihang to join Gao Huan.

sentences.zh: 隆之解行臺，仍為大丞相軍司。

translations.literal: Longzhi relinquished the mobile office and remained chief clerk of the great chancellor's army.
translations.idiomatic: Longzhi gave up the mobile office and remained chief clerk of the great chancellor's army.

sentences.zh: 齊獻武王次於武鄉，尒朱兆大掠晉陽，北走秀容。

translations.literal: Gao Huan halted at Wuxiang; Erzhu Zhao greatly plundered Jinyang and fled north to Xiurong.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan camped at Wuxiang; Erzhu Zhao plundered Jinyang heavily and fled north to Xiurong.

sentences.zh: 并州平。

translations.literal: Bing Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Bing province was pacified.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，帝臨顯陽殿，親理冤獄。

translations.literal: On yimao day the emperor entered the Xianyang Hall and personally judged cases of wrongful punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the emperor entered the Xianyang Hall and personally judged cases of wrongful punishment.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以宗師、東萊王貴平為車騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Guiping, Prince of Donglai, director of the imperial clan, was made general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Guiping, prince of Donglai, director of the imperial clan, was made general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 是月，夏州徙民郭遷據宥州反，刺史元嶷棄城走。

translations.literal: That month resettled people of Xia Province: Guo Qian of You Province rebelled and occupied it; Regional Inspector Yuan Yi abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: That month resettled people of Xia province rebelled: Guo Qian of You province seized the province; Yuan Yi, regional inspector, abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: [7]詔行臺侯景率齊州刺史尉景、濟州刺史蔡儁等攻討之。

translations.literal: [7] An edict ordered Grand Mobile Office Hou Jing to lead Qi regional inspector Wei Jing, Ji regional inspector Cai Jun, and others to attack and suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: [7] An edict ordered Hou Jing, grand mobile office, to lead Wei Jing, regional inspector of Qi, Cai Jun, regional inspector of Ji, and others to attack and suppress him.

sentences.zh: 城陷，遷奔蕭衍。

translations.literal: When the city fell, Qian fled to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, Qian fled to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 東南道大行臺樊子鵠大破蕭衍軍於譙城，擒其鄴王元樹及譙州刺史朱文開。

translations.literal: Fan Zihong, grand mobile office of the southeast route, greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army at Qiao city and captured his Prince of Ye Yuan Shu and regional inspector of Qiao Zhu Wenkai.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zihong, grand mobile office of the southeast route, greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army at Qiao city and captured his prince of Ye Yuan Shu and Zhu Wenkai, regional inspector of Qiao.

sentences.zh: 八月壬戌朔，齊文襄王來朝，燕射，班賚部下各有差。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon on renxu day: Gao Cheng came to court; they feasted and shot together, and gifts to subordinates were graded.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renxu new moon, Gao Cheng came to court; they feasted and shot together, and gifts to subordinates were graded.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以西中郎將元寧為高平王。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Ning, western middle cadet-general, was made Prince of Gaoping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Ning, western middle cadet-general, was made prince of Gaoping.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以車騎大將軍、左光祿大夫李琰之為儀同三司。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Yan Zhi, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Yan Zhi, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以車騎將軍、左光祿大夫崔秉為驃騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Bing, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Cui Bing, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以車騎將軍、右光祿大夫高岳為驃騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Yue, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the right halberd, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Gao Yue, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the right halberd, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，以侍中、驃騎大將軍、左光祿大夫封津為儀同三司。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on guiwei day Jin, attendant-in-ordinary, general of agile cavalry, and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiwei day Feng Jin, attendant-in-ordinary, general of agile cavalry, and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 庚子，帝幸華林都亭，引見元樹及公卿百僚蕃使督將等，宴射，班賚各有差。

translations.literal: On gengzi day the emperor visited the Hualin metropolitan pavilion and received Yuan Shu and ducal ministers, the hundred offices, foreign envoys, supervisors, and generals, and feasted with archery; gifts were graded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the emperor visited the Hualin metropolitan pavilion and received Yuan Shu, ducal ministers, the hundred offices, foreign envoys, supervisors, and generals; they feasted with archery and gifts were graded.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，燕郡開國公賀拔允進爵為王。

translations.literal: On guimao day Yun, Duke of Yan Commandery with open state, was advanced in rank to prince.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao He Ba Yun, duke of Yan commandery with open state, was advanced in rank to prince.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，帝幸都水，南過洛汭、遂至瀍澗。

translations.literal: On yisi day the emperor visited the metropolitan waterworks, passed south over the Luo ford, and went on to the Chan and Jian streams.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the emperor visited the metropolitan waterworks, passed south over the Luo ford, and went on to the Chan and Jian streams.

sentences.zh: 己酉，復田于北原。

translations.literal: On jiyou day the hunt was resumed on the northern plain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the hunt was resumed on the northern plain.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以太師、沛王欣為廣陵王，前廢帝子勃海王子恕改封沛郡王。

translations.literal: On guichou day Xin, grand preceptor and Prince of Pei, was made Prince of Guangling; Zishu, son of the former emperor's Prince of Bohai, was reassigned Prince of Pei Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Xin, grand preceptor and prince of Pei, was made prince of Guangling; Zishu, son of the former emperor's prince of Bohai, was reassigned prince of Pei commandery.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以侍中、驃騎大將軍封隆之，[8]任祥並為儀同三司。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Longzhi, attendant-in-ordinary and general of agile cavalry, [8] and Ren Xiang were both made bearers of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Feng Longzhi, attendant-in-ordinary and general of agile cavalry, [8] and Ren Xiang were both made bearers of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 以車騎大將軍、河南尹元仲景為驃騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Zhongjing, general of chariots and cavalry and governor of Henan as Yuan, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zhongjing, general of chariots and cavalry and governor of Henan, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，車駕謁山陵。

translations.literal: On yimao day the imperial carriage paid respects at the mountain tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the imperial carriage paid respects at the mountain tombs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，蠕蠕、高昌國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Rouran and Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Rouran and Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以衞將軍、前吏部尚書李神雋，撫軍將軍、右衞將軍婁昭並為驃騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Shenjun, former director of the Masters of Writing for personnel, guard-general, and Lou Zhao, general who stabilizes the army and right guard-general, were both made generals of agile cavalry and bearers of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Li Shenjun, former director of the Masters of Writing for personnel, guard-general, and Lou Zhao, general who stabilizes the army and right guard-general, were both made generals of agile cavalry and bearers of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，以使持節、衞將軍、光州刺史高仲密為車騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on jiazi day Zhongmi, regional inspector of Guang with bearer of the staff and full powers and guard-general, was made general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiazi day Gao Zhongmi, regional inspector of Guang with bearer of the staff and full powers and guard-general, was made general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以車騎大將軍、左光祿大夫潘蠻為儀同三司。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Man, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Pan Man, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以車騎大將軍、左光祿大夫高琛為特進、驃騎、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On jimao day Chen, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made specially advanced, general of agile cavalry, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Gao Chen, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made specially advanced, general of agile cavalry, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以使持節、驃騎將軍、肆州刺史劉貴為驃騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Gui, general of agile cavalry and regional inspector of Si with bearer of the staff and full powers, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Liu Gui, general of agile cavalry and regional inspector of Si with bearer of the staff and full powers, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 十有一月甲午，以車騎將軍、揚州刺史斛斯敦為驃騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiawu day Dun, general of chariots and cavalry and regional inspector of Yang, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiawu day Hu Sigun Dun, general of chariots and cavalry and regional inspector of Yang, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，日南至，車駕有事於圓丘。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the winter solstice, the imperial carriage performed the rites at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the winter solstice, the imperial carriage performed rites at the Round Mound.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，朝會百官於太極前殿。

translations.literal: On wuxu day an assembly was held for the hundred offices at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an assembly was held for the hundred offices at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，安定王朗及東海王曄坐事死。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Lang, Prince of Anding, and Ye, Prince of Donghai, were put to death for their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Houfei, prince of Anding, and Ye, prince of Donghai, were put to death for their crimes.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，蠕蠕國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On yisi day Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以前太尉公、汝南王悅為侍中、大司馬、開府。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Yue, former Duke of the State as grandee of Taiwei and Prince of Runan, was made attendant-in-ordinary, grand marshal, and commander with open office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Yue, former grandee of taiwei and prince of Runan, was made attendant-in-ordinary, grand marshal, and commander with open office.

sentences.zh: 葬靈太后胡氏。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Hu was buried.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Hu was buried.

sentences.zh: 十有二月丙寅，以驃騎大將軍、領御史中尉綦雋為儀同三司。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on bingyin day Jun, general of agile cavalry and director of the Censorate, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingyin day Qi Jun, general of agile cavalry and director of the censorate, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以侍中、廣平王贊為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On yihai day Zan, attendant-in-ordinary and Prince of Guangping, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zan, attendant-in-ordinary and prince of Guangping, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，殺大司馬、汝南王悅。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Yue, grand marshal and Prince of Runan, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Yue, grand marshal and prince of Runan, was killed.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，改太昌為永興，以太宗號，尋改為永熙元年。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed; Taichang was changed to Yongxing, taking the Taizong era name; it was soon changed to Yongxi year 1.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed; Taichang became Yongxing under the Taizong era name, soon changed to Yongxi year 1.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，以使持節、鎮東將軍、行汾州事張瓊為驃騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Second month, on gengshen day Qiong, general who pacifies the east with bearer of the staff and full powers and acting overseer of Fen Province affairs, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen day Zhang Qiong, general who pacifies the east with bearer of the staff and full powers and acting overseer of Fen province affairs, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以司空公高乾邕為使持節、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，[9]咸陽王坦為司空公。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Qianzong, Duke of the State as minister of works, was made bearer of the staff with full powers, general of agile cavalry, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office; [9] Tan, Prince of Xianyang, was made Duke of the State as minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Gao Qianzong, minister of works, was made bearer of the staff with full powers, general of agile cavalry, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office; [9] Tan, prince of Xianyang, was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊辰，詔諸參佐自三府以下爰及外州，皆不得復加常侍及兼兩員，雖已授者亦悉追之。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, on wuchen day an edict said that aides from the Three Offices downward and also the outer provinces must not again add regular attendant or concurrent second posts; even those already appointed were all to be revoked.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuchen day an edict said that aides from the Three Offices downward and also the outer provinces must not again add regular attendant or concurrent second posts; even those already appointed were all to be revoked.

sentences.zh: 是月，青州人耿翔襲據膠州，殺刺史裴粲，通於蕭衍。

translations.literal: That month a man of Qing Province, Geng Xiang, raided and seized Jiao Province, killed Regional Inspector Pei Can, and joined Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Geng Xiang of Qing province raided and seized Jiao province, killed Pei Can, regional inspector, and joined Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，詔諸幽枉未申，事經一周已上，悉集華林，將親覽察；

translations.literal: Fifth month, on gengyin day an edict said that where wrongful imprisonment had not been heard and the matter had passed a full year or more, all were to assemble at Hualin and the emperor would personally examine them;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengyin day an edict said that where wrongful imprisonment had not been heard and the matter had passed a full year or more, all were to assemble at Hualin and the emperor would personally examine them;

sentences.zh: 脫事已經年，有司不列者，聽其人各自陳訴；

translations.literal: if the matter had passed years yet the responsible office did not list it, the persons involved might each present their own appeal;
translations.idiomatic: if years had passed and the office did not list the case, the person might present his own appeal;

sentences.zh: 若事連州郡、由緣淹歲者，亦仰尚書總集以聞。

translations.literal: if the matter involved multiple provinces and commanderies and dragged on for years through connection, they were also to report collectively to the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: if the matter ran through several provinces and commanderies and dragged on for years, it was also to be reported collectively to the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以使持節、驃騎大將軍、儀同三司、齊州刺史侯淵復為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On renyin day Yuan, former general of agile cavalry, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, and regional inspector of Qi, was restored to bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Hou Yuan, former general of agile cavalry, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, and regional inspector of Qi, was restored to bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔曰：「大夫之職，位秩貴顯；

translations.literal: On yisi day an edict said: "The office of grandee—rank and status are honored and eminent;
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day an edict said, "The office of grandee—rank and status are honored and eminent;

sentences.zh: 員外之官，亦為匪賤。

translations.literal: the outer-quota office too is no slight post.
translations.idiomatic: the outer-quota office too is no slight post.

sentences.zh: 而下及胥吏，帶領非一，高卑渾雜，有損彝章。

translations.literal: Yet down to clerks and attendants, concurrent titles are not one kind; high and low are muddled together, to the harm of canonical pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Yet down to clerks and attendants titles were heaped on without limit; high and low were muddled, harming canonical pattern.

sentences.zh: 自今已後，京官樂為稱事小職者，直加散號將軍，願罷卑官者聽為大夫及員外之職，不宜仍前散實參領。

translations.literal: From this time forward, capital officials who prefer to take small offices by formal title may be directly given the scattered designation general; those who wish to relinquish humble offices may serve as grandee or outer-quota offices—it is unsuitable to continue as before with scattered substantive concurrent titles."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth capital officials who prefer a small office by formal title may receive only the scattered designation general; those who wish to leave humble posts may take grandee or outer-quota office—it is unsuitable to continue scattered substantive concurrent titles as before."

sentences.zh: 其中旨特加者，不在此例。

translations.literal: Those specially advanced by central intent are outside this rule."
translations.idiomatic: Cases specially advanced by central intent are excepted from this rule."

sentences.zh: 」東徐州城民王早、簡實等殺刺史崔庠，據州入蕭衍。

translations.literal: The townspeople Wang Zao and Jian Shi of East Xu Province killed Regional Inspector Cui Xiang, seized the province, and submitted to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: The townspeople Wang Zao and Jian Shi of East Xu province killed Cui Xiang, regional inspector, seized the province, and submitted to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，以驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、尚書右僕射樊子鵠為青膠大使，督濟州刺史、大都督蔡儁討耿翔。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renshen day Fan Zihong, general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office and right vice director of the Masters of Writing, was made envoy to Qing and Jiao, supervising Ji regional inspector and grand commander Cai Jun to attack Geng Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renshen day Fan Zihong, general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office and right vice director of the Masters of Writing, was made envoy to Qing and Jiao, supervising Cai Jun, regional inspector of Ji and grand commander, to attack Geng Xiang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以驃騎大將軍、前行南兗州事念賢為儀同三司。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Xian, former general of agile cavalry and acting overseer of South Yan Province affairs, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Nian Xian, former general of agile cavalry and acting overseer of South Yan province affairs, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，以使持節、鎮北將軍、大都督、秦州刺史万俟普撥為驃騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on xinmao day Pubo, general who pacifies the north, grand commander, and regional inspector of Qin with bearer of the staff and full powers, of the Wanqi clan, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinmao day Wanqi Pubo, general who pacifies the north, grand commander, and regional inspector of Qin with bearer of the staff and full powers, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: [12]壬辰，以太師、司州牧、廣陵王欣為大司馬、侍中，以太尉公、趙郡王諶為太師，並開府。

translations.literal: [12] On renchen day Xin, grand preceptor, regional inspector of Si, and Prince of Guangling, was made grand marshal and attendant-in-ordinary; Chen, Duke of the State as grandee of Taiwei and Prince of Zhao Commandery, was made grand preceptor; both opened offices.
translations.idiomatic: [12] On renchen day Xin, grand preceptor, regional inspector of Si, and prince of Guangling, was made grand marshal and attendant-in-ordinary; Chen, grandee of taiwei and prince of Zhao commandery, was made grand preceptor; both opened offices.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以前司徒公、燕郡王賀拔允為太尉公。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Yun, former Duke of the State as grandee of the Grandee and Prince of Yan Commandery, was made Duke of the State as grandee of Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu He Ba Yun, former grandee of the grandee and prince of Yan commandery, was made grandee of taiwei.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，齊文襄王來朝，帝燕於華林都亭，班賚部下各有差。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on yichou day Gao Cheng came to court; the emperor feasted him at the Hualin metropolitan pavilion, and gifts to subordinates were graded.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yichou day Gao Cheng came to court; the emperor feasted him at the Hualin metropolitan pavilion, and gifts to subordinates were graded.

sentences.zh: 以驃騎大將軍、前南岐州刺史司馬子如為儀同三司。

translations.literal: Sima Ziru, former general of agile cavalry and regional inspector of South Qi, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Ziru, former general of agile cavalry and inspector of South Qi, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，車駕餞文襄王於河梁，仍濟河而返。

translations.literal: On wuchen day the imperial carriage saw Gao Cheng off at Hey Bridge and then crossed the river and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the imperial carriage saw Gao Cheng off at Hey Bridge and then crossed the river and returned.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，齊獻武王上表固讓王爵，不許；

translations.literal: On guiyou day Gao Huan submitted a memorial firmly declining the princely rank; it was not granted;
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Gao Huan submitted a memorial firmly declining the princely rank; it was not granted;

sentences.zh: 請分邑十萬戶，節降為品，回授勳義，從之。

translations.literal: he requested that one hundred thousand households of his fief be divided, ranks reduced to grades, and returned to reward merit and righteousness; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: he asked to divide one hundred thousand households of fief, reduce ranks to grades, and return the portion to reward merit and righteousness; this was granted.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，以散騎常侍、車騎大將軍、左光祿大夫崔孝芬為儀同三司。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renzi day Cui Xiaofen, scattered cavalier attendant, general of chariots and cavalry, and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi day Cui Xiaofen, scattered cavalier attendant, general of chariots and cavalry, and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，以衞將軍、瓜州刺史、泰臨縣開國伯、高昌王麴子堅為儀同三司，進爵郡王。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on guiwei day Jian, guard-general, regional inspector of Gua, Marquis of Tailin with open state, and King of Gaochang, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies and advanced in rank to prince of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guiwei day Qu Zijian, guard-general, regional inspector of Gua, marquis of Tailin with open state, and king of Gaochang, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies and advanced in rank to prince of the commandery.

translations.literal: The text is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The text is deficient.

sentences.zh: 十有一月癸巳，持節、征北將軍、殷州刺史邸珍為徐州大都督、東道行臺僕射，率將討東徐州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on guisi day Zhen, general who campaigns north with bearer of the staff and regional inspector of Yin, was made grand commander of Xu Province, vice director of the eastern-route grand mobile office, and led generals to attack East Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guisi day Di Zhen, general who campaigns north with bearer of the staff and regional inspector of Yin, was made grand commander of Xu province, vice director of the eastern-route grand mobile office, and led generals to attack East Xu province.

sentences.zh: 十有二月丁巳，車駕狩於嵩陽。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dingsi day the imperial carriage hunted at Songyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingsi day the imperial carriage hunted at Songyang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遂幸溫湯。

translations.literal: On jisi day he then visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he then visited the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月壬辰，齊獻武王討費也頭於河西苦洩河，大破之，獲其帥紇豆陵伊利，遷其部落於內地。

translations.literal: Third year, first month of spring, on renchen day Gao Huan attacked the Feiye Tou at Kuxie River west of the river in Hexi, greatly defeated them, captured their leader Hedouling Yili, and moved their tribes to the interior.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, first month of spring, on renchen day Gao Huan attacked the Feiye Tou at Kuxie River west of the river in Hexi, greatly defeated them, captured their leader Hedouling Yili, and moved their tribes to the interior.

sentences.zh: 二月，東梁州為夷民侵逼，詔使持節、車騎大將軍、行東雍州事泉企為東梁州行臺、都督以討之。

translations.literal: Second month: East Liang Province was pressed by barbarian peoples; an edict made Quan Qi, general of chariots and cavalry with bearer of the staff and full powers and acting overseer of East Yong Province affairs, eastern-route grand mobile office and commander to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month East Liang province was pressed by barbarian peoples; an edict made Quan Qi, general of chariots and cavalry with bearer of the staff and full powers and acting overseer of East Yong province affairs, eastern-route grand mobile office and commander, to attack them.

sentences.zh: 己未，蕭衍假節、豫州刺史、南昌王毛香舉城內附，授以持節、安南將軍、信州刺史、義昌王。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Mao Xiang of Xiao Yan, with acting staff, regional inspector of Yu, and Prince of Nanchang, brought his city in to submit; he was appointed bearer of the staff, general who pacifies the south, regional inspector of Xin, and Prince of Yichang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Mao Xiang of Xiao Yan, with acting staff, regional inspector of Yu, and prince of Nanchang, brought his city in to submit; he was appointed bearer of the staff, general who pacifies the south, regional inspector of Xin, and prince of Yichang.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On renxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丙子，帝親釋奠禮先師。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the emperor personally performed the libation-and-sacrifice rite to the former teacher.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the emperor personally performed the libation-and-sacrifice rite to the former teacher.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，幸洪池陂，遂遊田。

translations.literal: On xinsi day he visited Hongchi Pond and then went hunting.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he visited Hongchi Pond and then went hunting.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以衞將軍、前徐州刺史元祐為衞大將軍、儀同三司，以驃騎將軍、左衞將軍元斌之為潁川王。

translations.literal: On renwu day You, former guard-general and regional inspector of Xu, was made guard-general and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies; Binzhi, general of agile cavalry and left guard-general, was made Prince of Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Yuan You, former guard-general and regional inspector of Xu, was made guard-general and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies; Yuan Binzhi, general of agile cavalry and left guard-general, was made prince of Yingchuan.

translations.literal: The text is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The text is deficient.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，以前侍中、車騎大將軍李彧為驃騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Third month, on renyin day Yu, former attendant-in-ordinary and general of chariots and cavalry, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renyin day Li Yu, former attendant-in-ordinary and general of chariots and cavalry, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，契丹國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, on wuwu day Khitan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuwu day Khitan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛未，高平王寧坐事降爵為公。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Ning, Prince of Gaoping, was reduced for an offense in rank to duke.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Ning, prince of Gaoping, was reduced for an offense in rank to duke.

sentences.zh: 丙子，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，增置勳府庶子，廂別六百人，又增騎官，廂別二百人，依第出身，騎官秩比直齋。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on bingxu day additional aides of the Merit Office were established, six hundred per wing in separate wings; cavalry officers were also increased, two hundred per wing by graded origin; cavalry officers' rank equaled direct attendants at the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingxu day additional aides of the Merit Office were established, six hundred per wing in separate wings; cavalry officers were also increased, two hundred per wing by graded origin; cavalry officers' rank equaled direct attendants at the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔曰：「大魏得一居宸，乘六馭宇。

translations.literal: On xinmao day an edict said: "Great Wei, having obtained the One, dwells upon the throne and rides the six reins over the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict said, "Great Wei, having obtained the One, dwells upon the throne and rides the six reins over the realm.

sentences.zh: 考風雲之所會，宅日月之所中。

translations.literal: It examines where wind and cloud meet and dwells where sun and moon stand at center.
translations.idiomatic: It took as dwelling the place where wind and cloud meet and where sun and moon stand at the center.

sentences.zh: 自北而南，東征西怨，后來其蘇，無思不偃。

translations.literal: From north to south, campaigning east and soothing west, those who came later were revived—none whose thoughts did not bow.
translations.idiomatic: From north to south, campaigning east and pacifying west, the latecomers were revived—none whose heart did not submit.

sentences.zh: 而句吳負險，久遺度外。

translations.literal: Yet Gou Wu bore the terrain's advantage and long lay outside Our measure.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Gou Wu held rugged terrain and long remained beyond Our borders.

sentences.zh: 世祖太武皇帝，握金鏡以照耀，擊玉鼓以鏗鏘，神武之所牢籠，威風之所轥轢，莫不雲徹霧卷，瓦解冰消。

translations.literal: Grand Progenitor Emperor Taiwu, holding the golden mirror to shine abroad and striking the jade drum to ring clear—what divine martial prowess could cage and what majestic wind could crush—all alike dissolved like clouds scattering in mist, ice melting away.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Emperor Taiwu held the golden mirror to shine abroad and struck the jade drum to ring clear—whatever his divine martial prowess caged and his majestic wind crushed alike dissolved as clouds scatter in mist and ice melts away.

sentences.zh: 長江已北，盡為魏土。

translations.literal: North of the Yangtze all became Wei territory.
translations.idiomatic: North of the Yangtze all became Wei territory.

sentences.zh: 頃天步中圮，國綱時屯，凶竪因機，互窺上國，疆埸侵噬，州郡淪胥。

translations.literal: Recently heaven's step faltered at center and the state's cord was straitened in its season; vicious minions seized the moment and each peeped at the upper realm—borders were gnawed away and provinces and commanderies fell.
translations.idiomatic: Lately heaven's step faltered at the center and the state's cord tightened in its season; vicious men seized the moment and each eyed the upper realm—borders were gnawed away and provinces and commanderies were lost.

sentences.zh: 乃眷東顧，無忘寢食。

translations.literal: We turn Our gaze eastward and cannot forget even in sleep and meals.
translations.idiomatic: We turn Our gaze eastward and cannot forget it even in sleep and meals.

sentences.zh: 自非五牛警旆，七萃按部，何以復文武之舊業，拯塗炭於遺黎？

translations.literal: Unless the five oxen raise the banners and the seven elite array their ranks, how restore the old enterprise of Wen and Wu and rescue the people from charcoal in their remnant lives?"
translations.idiomatic: Unless the five oxen raise the banners and the seven elite array their ranks, how can We restore Wen and Wu's old enterprise and rescue the people from charcoal in their remnant lives?"

sentences.zh: 朕將親總六軍，徑臨彭、汴。

translations.literal: We shall personally command the six armies and march straight to Peng and Bian.
translations.idiomatic: We shall personally command the six armies and march directly to Peng and Bian.

sentences.zh: 一勞永逸，庶保無疆。

translations.literal: One labor to end it forever—thus may the realm long be preserved without bounds.
translations.idiomatic: One campaign to end the trouble forever—thus may the realm long endure without bounds.

sentences.zh: 內外百僚，便可嚴備。

translations.literal: The hundred offices within and without may at once make strict preparation.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred offices within and without should make strict preparation at once.

sentences.zh: 出頓之期，更聽後敕。

translations.literal: The date of departure for encampment—listen for a later edict."
translations.idiomatic: The date for setting out to camp—await a later edict."

sentences.zh: 」時帝為斛斯椿、元毗、王思政、魏光等謟佞間阻，貳於齊獻武王，託討蕭衍，盛暑徵發河南諸州之兵，天下怪惡之。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor, because Hu Sigun Chun, Yuan Pi, Wang Sizheng, Wei Guang, and others flattered and slandered and came between, turned disloyal toward Gao Huan; under the pretext of attacking Xiao Yan he requisitioned troops from the Henan provinces in the height of summer—the realm was shocked and revolted.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the emperor, because Hu Sigun Chun, Yuan Pi, Wang Sizheng, Wei Guang, and others flattered and slandered and came between, turned disloyal toward Gao Huan; under pretext of attacking Xiao Yan he requisitioned troops from the Henan provinces in high summer—the realm was shocked and revolted.

sentences.zh: 語在斛斯椿傳。

translations.literal: The account is in the Biography of Hu Sigun Chun.
translations.idiomatic: The account is in the Biography of Hu Sigun Chun.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以使持節、侍中、大司馬、開府、司州牧、廣陵王欣為左軍大都督，太傅、錄尚書事長孫稚為中軍四面大都督。

translations.literal: On bingshen day Xin, attendant-in-ordinary, grand marshal, commander with open office, regional inspector of Si, and Prince of Guangling, with bearer of the staff and full powers, was made grand commander of the left army; Chun, grand tutor, recorder of affairs for the Masters of Writing, was made grand commander on all four sides of the center army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Xin, attendant-in-ordinary, grand marshal, commander with open office, regional inspector of Si, and prince of Guangling, with bearer of the staff and full powers, was made grand commander of the left army; Chun, grand tutor, recorder of affairs for the Masters of Writing, was made grand commander on all four sides of the center army.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，帝幸華林都亭，集京畿都督及軍士三千餘人，慰勉之。

translations.literal: On dingyou day the emperor visited the Hualin metropolitan pavilion, assembled metropolitan-area commanders and more than three thousand soldiers, and comforted and exhorted them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the emperor visited the Hualin metropolitan pavilion, assembled metropolitan-area commanders and more than three thousand soldiers, and comforted and exhorted them.

sentences.zh: 庚子，又幸華林都亭納訟。

translations.literal: On gengzi day he again visited the Hualin metropolitan pavilion to hear lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he again visited the Hualin metropolitan pavilion to hear lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，又以長孫稚為後軍大都督。

translations.literal: On renyin day Chun was again made grand commander of the rear army.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Chun was again made grand commander of the rear army.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，大都督源子恭鎮胡陽，汝陽王暹守石濟，儀同三司賈顯智率豫州刺史斛斯壽東趨濟州。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on dingmao day Grand Commander Yuan Zigong garrisoned Huyang; Prince of Ruyang Xian guarded Shiji; Jia Xianzhi, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, led Regional Inspector Hu Sigun Shou east toward Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingmao day Yuan Zigong, grand commander, garrisoned Huyang; Xian, prince of Ruyang, guarded Shiji; Jia Xianzhi, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, led Hu Sigun Shou, regional inspector of Yu, east toward Ji province.

sentences.zh: 庚午，吐谷渾國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔曰：「頃年以來，天步時阻，干戈不戢，荊棘斯生。

translations.literal: On bingzi day an edict said: "In recent years heaven's step has been obstructed in season; arms have not been laid down and brambles have sprung up.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day an edict said, "In recent years heaven's step has been obstructed in season; arms have not been laid down and brambles have sprung up.

sentences.zh: 或徇節感恩，奮不顧命；

translations.literal: Some upheld integrity and repaid kindness, striving without regard for life;
translations.idiomatic: Some kept faith and repaid kindness, striving without heed for their lives;

sentences.zh: 或臨戎對敵，赴難如歸。

translations.literal: some faced the foe at the frontier and went to hardship as if returning home.
translations.idiomatic: some met the foe at the frontier and went to hardship as if returning home.

sentences.zh: 身首橫分，骸骨不斂。

translations.literal: Bodies were cut apart and bones left ungathered.
translations.idiomatic: Bodies were cut apart and bones left ungathered.

sentences.zh: 勳誠靡錄，榮贈莫加。

translations.literal: Merit and loyalty went unrecorded; honors and posthumous gifts were not added.
translations.idiomatic: Merit and loyalty were not recorded; honors and posthumous gifts were not granted.

sentences.zh: 寤寐矜之，良有嗟悼。

translations.literal: Awake and asleep We pity them—truly there is sighing and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Awake and asleep We pity them—truly We sigh and mourn.

sentences.zh: 可普告內外，所在言列。

translations.literal: Let this be proclaimed within and without; let each locality report and list.
translations.idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed within and without; let each locality report and list the cases.

sentences.zh: 若無親近，聽故友陳之。

translations.literal: Where there are no kin near, let old friends present the case.
translations.idiomatic: Where there are no kin near, let old friends present the matter.

sentences.zh: 尚書檢實，隨狀科贈。

translations.literal: The Masters of Writing shall verify the facts and grant posthumous rewards according to the case.
translations.idiomatic: The Masters of Writing shall verify the facts and grant rewards posthumously according to the case.

sentences.zh: 庶粗慰冤魂，少申惻隱。

translations.literal: Thus may We roughly comfort wronged souls and slightly express compassion."
translations.idiomatic: Thus may We roughly comfort wronged souls and slightly show compassion."

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，以使持節、車騎大將軍、中軍大都督斛律沙門為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Shamen, general of chariots and cavalry with bearer of the staff and full powers and grand commander of the center army, of the Hulu clan, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Hulu Shamen, general of chariots and cavalry with bearer of the staff and full powers and grand commander of the center army, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳朔，以鎮東將軍、前大鴻臚卿、太原王昶特為車騎大將軍、[15]儀同三司。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, new moon on xinsi day: Chang, Prince of Taiyuan, general who pacifies the east, former grand minister of the imperial clan, was specially made general of chariots and cavalry [15] and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, new moon on xinsi day: Chang, prince of Taiyuan, general who pacifies the east, former grand minister of the imperial clan, was specially made general of chariots and cavalry [15] and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 己丑，帝親總六軍十餘萬眾次於河橋。

translations.literal: On jichou day the emperor personally commanded more than one hundred thousand of the six armies and halted at Hey Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the emperor personally commanded more than one hundred thousand of the six armies and halted at Hey Bridge.

sentences.zh: 以斛斯椿為前軍大都督，尋詔椿鎮虎牢。

translations.literal: Hu Sigun Chun was made grand commander of the vanguard army; soon an edict ordered Chun to garrison Hulao.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Sigun Chun was made grand commander of the vanguard; soon an edict ordered Chun to garrison Hulao.

sentences.zh: 又詔荊州刺史賀拔勝赴於行所。

translations.literal: Another edict ordered He Ba Sheng, regional inspector of Jing, to hurry to the imperial encampment.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered He Ba Sheng, inspector of Jing, to hurry to the imperial encampment.

sentences.zh: 勝率所部次於汝水。

translations.literal: Sheng led his command and halted at the Ru River.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng led his command and halted at the Ru River.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以使持節、征西將軍、岐州刺史越肱特為儀同三司。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Yue Gu, general who campaigns west with bearer of the staff and regional inspector of Qi, was specially made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Yue Gu, general who campaigns west with bearer of the staff and regional inspector of Qi, was specially made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 丁未，帝為椿等迫脅，遂出於長安。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the emperor, compelled by Chun and the others, then went out to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the emperor, compelled by Chun and the others, then went out to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 己酉，齊獻武王入洛，賀拔勝走還荊州。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Gao Huan entered Luoyang; He Ba Sheng fled back to Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Gao Huan entered Luoyang; He Ba Sheng fled back to Jing province.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，推司徒公、清河王亶為大司馬，承制總萬幾，居尚書省。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jiayin day Xuan, Duke of the State as grandee of the Grandee and Prince of Qinghe, was advanced as grand marshal, received the regency to direct all affairs, and dwelt in the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiayin day Xuan, grandee of the grandee and prince of Qinghe, was advanced as grand marshal, received the regency to direct all affairs, and dwelt in the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，齊獻武王西迎車駕。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Gao Huan went west to welcome the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Gao Huan went west to welcome the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，制曰：「晦為明始，亂實治基，爰著天道，又符人事。

translations.literal: On wuchen day a regency edict said: "Darkness is the beginning of brightness; disorder is truly the foundation of order—this is set forth in heaven's way and again matches human affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day a regency edict said, "Darkness is the beginning of brightness; disorder is truly the foundation of order—this is set forth in heaven's way and again matches human affairs.

sentences.zh: 故姬祚中微，踐土有勤王之役；

translations.literal: Thus when the Ji house faltered at center, there was the toiling campaign of those who upheld the king at Tiantu;
translations.idiomatic: Thus when the Ji house faltered at center, there was the campaign of those who upheld the king at Tiantu;

sentences.zh: 劉氏將傾，北軍致左袒之舉。

translations.literal: when the Liu house was about to fall, the northern army raised the baring of the left shoulder.
translations.idiomatic: when the Liu house was about to fall, the northern army bared the left shoulder.

sentences.zh: 用能隆此遠年，克茲卜世。

translations.literal: By this they could elevate those distant years and secure this divined age.
translations.idiomatic: By this they could elevate those distant years and secure the divined age.

sentences.zh: 永熙之季，權佞擅朝，羣小是崇，勳賢見害。

translations.literal: In the Yongxi season violent minions monopolized the court; petty men were honored and meritorious worthies were harmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongxi season violent minions monopolized the court; petty men were honored and worthy ministers were harmed.

sentences.zh: 官緣價以貴賤，獄因貨而死生。

translations.literal: Office followed price in high and low; prisons followed bribes in life and death.
translations.idiomatic: Office followed price in rank; prisons followed bribes in life and death.

sentences.zh: 宗祏飄若綴旒，民命棄如草莽。

translations.literal: The ancestral temple swayed like a suspended tassel; the people's lives were cast away like grass in the wild.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral temple swayed like a hanging tassel; the people's lives were cast away like grass in the wild.

sentences.zh: 大丞相位居晉鄭，任屬桓文，興甲汾川，問罪伊洛。

translations.literal: The great chancellor's position matched Jin and Zheng; his charge matched Huan and Wen; he raised arms on the Fen River and questioned guilt at Yi and Luo.
translations.idiomatic: The great chancellor's position matched Jin and Zheng; his charge matched Huan and Wen; he raised arms on the Fen and questioned guilt at Yi and Luo.

sentences.zh: 羣姦畏威，擁迫人主，以自蔽衞，遠出秦方。

translations.literal: The vicious feared his might and, pressing the sovereign, used him to screen themselves and went far out to the Qin region.
translations.idiomatic: The vicious feared his might; pressing the sovereign, they used him to screen themselves and went far out to the Qin region.

sentences.zh: 雖車駕流移，未即返御，然權佞將除，天下延頸。

translations.literal: Though the imperial carriage drifted in displacement and did not at once return to rule, yet the violent minions would be removed and all under heaven craned their necks.
translations.idiomatic: Though the imperial carriage drifted and did not at once return to rule, yet the violent minions would be removed and all under heaven craned their necks.

sentences.zh: 魏邦雖舊，其化惟新，思與兆民，同茲更始。

translations.literal: The Wei state, though old, has only its transformation anew; We think to share with the hundred surnames this fresh beginning.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei state is old, but its transformation is new; We mean to share with the hundred surnames this fresh beginning.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: Let a general amnesty be proclaimed throughout the realm."

sentences.zh: 」行臺侯景討荊州，賀拔勝戰敗，走奔蕭衍。

translations.literal: Hou Jing, grand mobile office, attacked Jing Province; He Ba Sheng was defeated in battle and fled to submit to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing, grand mobile office, attacked Jing province; He Ba Sheng was defeated in battle and fled to submit to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，以衞大將軍、河南尹元子思為使持節、行臺僕射，使持節、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、領軍將軍婁昭為西道大都督，并率左右侍官西迎車駕。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on guisi day Zisi, guard-general and governor of Henan as Yuan, was made vice director of the grand mobile office with bearer of the staff and full powers; Zhao, army commander with bearer of the staff and full powers, general of agile cavalry, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, and commander of the palace guards, was made grand commander of the western route; both led the attendants of left and right to welcome the imperial carriage westward.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guisi day Yuan Zisi, guard-general and governor of Henan, was made vice director of the grand mobile office with bearer of the staff and full powers; Lou Zhao, army commander with bearer of the staff and full powers, general of agile cavalry, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, and commander of the palace guards, was made grand commander of the western route; both led the attendants of left and right to welcome the imperial carriage westward.

sentences.zh: 己酉，椿黨毛鴻賓守潼關，齊獻武王破擒之。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Mao Hongbin of Chun's faction held Tong Pass; Gao Huan broke and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Mao Hongbin of Chun's faction held Tong Pass; Gao Huan broke and captured him.

sentences.zh: [16]是日，齊獻武王東還於洛。

translations.literal: [16] That day Gao Huan returned east to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: [16] That day Gao Huan returned east to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 是月，東清河人傅皛殺太守韓子捷，據郡反。

translations.literal: That month Fu Xiao of East Qinghe killed Administrator Han Zijie, seized the commandery, and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fu Xiao of East Qinghe killed Han Zijie, administrator, seized the commandery, and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 會赦，乃降。

translations.literal: When an amnesty arrived, he then submitted.
translations.idiomatic: When an amnesty arrived, he then submitted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，使持節、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、行青州事侯淵克東陽，斬刺史東萊王貴平，[17]傳首京師。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on wuchen day Yuan, general of agile cavalry with bearer of the staff and full powers, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, and acting overseer of Qing Province affairs, took East Yang; he beheaded Regional Inspector Guiping, Prince of Donglai, [17] and sent the head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuchen day Hou Yuan, general of agile cavalry with bearer of the staff and full powers, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, and acting overseer of Qing province affairs, took East Yang; he beheaded Guiping, regional inspector and prince of Donglai, [17] and sent the head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月癸巳，帝為宇文黑獺所害，時年二十五。

translations.literal: Intercalary twelfth month, on guisi day the emperor was killed by Yuwen Heita; he was twenty-five.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary twelfth month, on guisi day the emperor was slain by Yuwen Heita; he was twenty-five years old.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：廣陵廢於前，中興廢於後，平陽猜惑，自絕宗廟。

translations.literal: The historians say: Guangling was deposed before, the Restoration was deposed after; Pingyang grew suspicious and cut himself off from the ancestral temples.
translations.idiomatic: The historians say: Guangling was deposed first and the Restoration afterward; Pingyang grew suspicious and severed himself from the ancestral temples.

sentences.zh: 普泰雅道居多，永熙悖德為甚。

translations.literal: Putai still held much of the correct Way; Yongxi's perverse virtue was worse.
translations.idiomatic: Putai still observed much of the correct Way; Yongxi's perverse conduct was worse.

sentences.zh: 是俱亡滅，天下所棄歟！

translations.literal: Both alike perished—were they abandoned by all under heaven!
translations.idiomatic: Both alike perished—had all under heaven abandoned them?

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Collation notes

sentences.zh: 就除金紫光祿大夫 百衲本、北本、汲本、殿本「就」作「執」，南本、局本作「就」。

translations.literal: Upon appointment as Grandee of the Golden Crown and Purple Radiance: in the Baina, Northern, Jibu, and Palace editions the character for "upon" is written as "hold"; Southern and Bureau editions read "upon."
translations.idiomatic: Upon appointment as grandee of the golden crown and purple radiance: the Baina, Northern, Jibu, and Palace editions write "upon" as "hold"; the Southern and Bureau editions read "upon."

sentences.zh: 按「執除」費解，今從南、局本。

translations.literal: Comment: "hold appointment" is hard to construe—now follow the Southern and Bureau editions.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: "hold appointment" makes poor sense—the Southern and Bureau readings are followed here.

sentences.zh: 擒其尚書左僕射儀同三司雲麾將軍徐兗二州刺史劉相如 卷九八蕭衍傳作「擒其雲麾將軍、徐兗二州刺史沈預，斬其宣猛將軍齊州刺史劉相如」。

translations.literal: Captured his Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat, palace attendant of the third rank, Cloud-Banner general, governor of Xu and Yan provinces Liu Xiangru. Juan 98, Biography of Xiao Yan, reads: "Captured his Cloud-Banner general, governor of Xu and Yan provinces Shen Yu; beheaded his Superlative Fierce general, governor of Qi province Liu Xiangru."
translations.idiomatic: They captured his left vice minister of the Secretariat, a palace attendant of the third rank and Cloud-Banner general who was governor of Xu and Yan provinces, Liu Xiangru. Juan 98 (Biography of Xiao Yan) has: they captured Cloud-Banner general and governor of Xu and Yan Shen Yu, and beheaded Superlative Fierce general and governor of Qi Liu Xiangru.

sentences.zh: 這裏「徐兗二州刺史」下有脫文，致誤合為一人。

translations.literal: Here below "governor of Xu and Yan provinces" text is missing, causing erroneous conflation into one person.
translations.idiomatic: Text is missing after "governor of Xu and Yan provinces," which wrongly merges two men into one.

sentences.zh: 又僕射、儀同的品級很高，不當只加「雲麾」軍號，邊州刺史也不可能有此官銜。

translations.literal: Moreover, vice minister and palace attendant of the third rank are very high ranks; one ought not add only the "Cloud-Banner" military title; border prefectural governors also could not hold such offices and titles.
translations.idiomatic: A vice minister and palace attendant of the third rank are exalted posts; they cannot be reduced to the Cloud-Banner military title alone, and a frontier prefect could not bear such a combination of offices.

sentences.zh: 必有誤。

translations.literal: There must be error.
translations.idiomatic: The passage must be corrupt.

sentences.zh: 以侍中太保開府尚書令樂平王尒朱世隆為儀同三師 諸本「師」作「司」。

translations.literal: Made palace attendant, grand guardian, chief minister with an open office, Prince of Leping Erzhu Shilong palace attendant of the third mentor rank: in all editions "mentor" is written "rank."
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Shilong, prince of Leping, already palace attendant, grand guardian, and chief minister with an open office, was made palace attendant of the third mentor rank; every edition writes "mentor" (shi) as "rank" (si).

sentences.zh: 按世隆已官「開府」，豈有加「儀同三司」之理。

translations.literal: Comment: Shilong already held "open office"—how could there be adding "palace attendant of the third rank"?
translations.idiomatic: Shilong already held an open office; he could not also receive the ordinary palace attendant of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 卷七五尒朱世隆傳稱：「前廢帝特置儀同三師之官，次上公之下，以世隆為之。

translations.literal: Juan 75, Biography of Erzhu Shilong, states: "The Former Deposed Emperor specially established the office of palace attendant of the third mentor rank, ranking below the three dukes; Shilong was appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: Juan 75 (Biography of Erzhu Shilong) says the Former Deposed Emperor created a special post of third-rank mentor, below the three dukes, and gave it to Shilong:

sentences.zh: 」這裏「司」乃「師」之訛，今據傳改正。

translations.literal: " Here "rank" is corruption of "mentor"; now corrected according to the biography.
translations.idiomatic: Here "rank" (si) is a corruption of "mentor" (shi); the biography is followed.

sentences.zh: 二年春三月齊獻武王敗尒朱天光等於韓陵 北史卷五「三月」作「閏二月」。

translations.literal: Year 2, spring, third month: the Duke of Qi, Filial and Martial King, defeated Erzhu Tianguang and others at Hanling. Beishi juan 5 writes "third month" as "intercalary second month."
translations.idiomatic: In year 2, spring, third month, the Duke of Qi, Filial and Martial King, defeated Erzhu Tianguang and others at Hanling; Beishi juan 5 has "intercalary second month" instead of "third month."

sentences.zh: 按本年

translations.literal: According to this year
translations.idiomatic: For that year

sentences.zh: 〈五三二〉
閏三月。

translations.literal: intercalary third month.
translations.idiomatic: there was an intercalary third month.

sentences.zh: 韓陵之戰在閏三月，歷見本卷下面後廢帝紀、北史卷六齊本紀，這裏「三月」上脫「閏」字，北史則「三」訛「二」。

translations.literal: The battle of Hanling was in the intercalary third month, repeatedly seen in this juan below in the Former Deposed Emperor annal and in Beishi juan 6, Qi basic annals; here "third month" lost "intercalary" above; Beishi then corrupted "three" to "two."
translations.idiomatic: Hanling fell in the intercalary third month, as repeated below in this juan (Former Deposed Emperor annal) and in Beishi juan 6 (Qi basic annals). Here "intercalary" dropped before "third month"; Beishi further changed "three" to "two."

sentences.zh: 鎮東將軍 張森楷云：「上文已書『鎮東』，此不應復為鎮東，前廢帝紀作『征東』，是也。

translations.literal: Pacification-East general Zhang Senkai states: "Above already wrote 'Pacification-East'; here it should not again be Pacification-East; the Former Deposed Emperor annal has 'Campaign-East,' which is correct.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Senkai notes: "Pacification-East was already written above; this line should not repeat it. The Former Deposed Emperor annal's Campaign-East is correct.

sentences.zh: 『鎮』字涉上而誤。」

translations.literal: The character 'Pacification' was carried down from above by error."
translations.idiomatic: The word 'Pacification' was copied down from the earlier line by mistake."

sentences.zh: 侍中驃騎大將軍開府儀同三司清河王亶儀同三師 諸本「師」訛「司」。

translations.literal: Palace attendant, rapid-as-lightning cavalry general, chief minister with an open office, Prince of Qinghe Dan, palace attendant of the third mentor rank: in all editions "mentor" is corrupted to "rank."
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Qinghe Dan, already palace attendant, rapid-as-lightning cavalry general, and chief minister with an open office, was made palace attendant of the third mentor rank; all editions corrupt "mentor" to "rank."

sentences.zh: 據卷七五尒朱世隆傳改正。

translations.literal: Corrected according to juan 75, Biography of Erzhu Shilong.
translations.idiomatic: Emended from juan 75 (Biography of Erzhu Shilong).

sentences.zh: 參本卷校記

translations.literal: See collation note in this juan
translations.idiomatic: See the collation note in this juan
(note 3)

sentences.zh: 夏州徙民郭遷據宥州反刺史元嶷棄城走 錢氏考異卷二八云：「宥非州名，通鑑卷一五五

translations.literal: Xia province migrants Guo Qian held You province in revolt; Governor Yuan Ni abandoned the city and fled. Qian's Examining Differences, juan 28, states: "You is not a province name; Zizhi tongjian juan 155
translations.idiomatic: Guo Qian of the Xia-province migrants seized You province and rebelled; Governor Yuan Ni abandoned the city and fled. Qian's Examining Differences (juan 28) says, "You is not a province name; Zizhi tongjian juan 155

sentences.zh: 〈四八二六頁〉
作青州，當從之。

translations.literal: reads Qing province; should follow that.
translations.idiomatic: has Qing province, which should be adopted."

sentences.zh: 」按本書卷一六常山王遵附元嶷傳、北齊書卷一九蔡儁傳，元嶷這時是兗州刺史，動亂發生在兗州。

translations.literal: " Comment: This book, juan 16, Biography of Prince of Changshan Zun, appendix Yuan Ni biography, and Beiqishu juan 19, Biography of Cai Jun, show Yuan Ni at this time was governor of Yan province; the unrest occurred in Yan province.
translations.idiomatic: This book juan 16 (Prince of Changshan Zun, appendix on Yuan Ni) and Beiqishu juan 19 (Cai Jun) place Yuan Ni as governor of Yan province when the revolt broke out there.

sentences.zh: 「宥州」果然是訛文，通鑑作「青州」也無據，郭遷所據之州應作「兗州」。

translations.literal: "You province" is indeed corrupted text; Tongjian's "Qing province" also has no basis; the province Guo Qian held should read "Yan province."
translations.idiomatic: "You province" is plainly wrong, and Tongjian's "Qing province" is equally unsupported; Guo Qian's base should read Yan province.

sentences.zh: 以侍中驃騎大將軍封隆之 諸本「隆」作「陰」。

translations.literal: Made palace attendant, rapid-as-lightning cavalry general Feng Longzhi: in all editions "Long" is written "Yin."
translations.idiomatic: Feng Longzhi was made palace attendant and rapid-as-lightning cavalry general; every edition writes "Long" as "Yin."

sentences.zh: 按當時並無「封陰之」其人，錢氏考異卷二八云：「『陰之』當是『隆之』之訛。

translations.literal: Comment: At the time there was no person "Feng Yinzhi"; Qian's Examining Differences, juan 28, states: "'Yinzhi' must be corruption of 'Longzhi.'
translations.idiomatic: No Feng Yinzhi existed then. Qian's Examining Differences (juan 28) says "Yinzhi" is a corruption of "Longzhi."

sentences.zh: 」錢說是，今改正。

translations.literal: " Qian's view is correct; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Qian is right; the text is emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 以司空公高乾邕為使持節驃騎大將軍開府儀同三司 張森楷云：「『儀同三司』下當有『徐州刺史』四字脫去，下文及高乾傳

translations.literal: Made Minister of Works Gao Ganyu commissioner with full powers, rapid-as-lightning cavalry general, chief minister with an open office, palace attendant of the third rank. Zhang Senkai states: "Below 'palace attendant of the third rank' the four characters 'governor of Xu province' were omitted; the text below and the Biography of Gao Gan
translations.idiomatic: Gao Ganyu, minister of works, was made commissioner with full powers, rapid-as-lightning cavalry general, chief minister with an open office, and palace attendant of the third rank. Zhang Senkai says the four words "governor of Xu province" dropped out after "palace attendant of the third rank," as the following passage and the Biography of Gao Gan

sentences.zh: 〈北齊書卷二一〉

translations.literal: (Beiqishu juan 21)
translations.idiomatic: (Beiqishu juan 21)

sentences.zh: 可證。」

translations.literal: can verify."
translations.idiomatic: confirm."

sentences.zh: 以使持節都督河渭部三州諸軍事 錢氏考異卷二八云：「部非州名，恐是『鄯』字之訛。」

translations.literal: Commissioner with full powers, commander-in-chief of military affairs of the He, Wei, and Bu three provinces: Qian's Examining Differences, juan 28, states: "Bu is not a province name; likely corruption of the character 'Shan.'"
translations.idiomatic: As commissioner with full powers commanding the He, Wei, and Bu three provinces: Qian's Examining Differences (juan 28) notes that Bu is not a province name and is probably a corruption of Shan.

sentences.zh: 侍中太尉公南陽王寶炬為太尉開府尚書令 北史卷五下「太尉」作「太保」。

translations.literal: Palace attendant, grand master, Duke of Nanyang Bao Ju, grand guardian, chief minister with an open office, palace attendant: Beishi juan 5, part 2, writes "grand master" as "grand guardian."
translations.idiomatic: Bao Ju, duke of Nanyang, palace attendant and grand master, was made grand guardian, chief minister with an open office, and palace attendant; Beishi juan 5, part 2, writes "grand master" as "grand guardian."

sentences.zh: 按寶炬先已為太尉，豈有以太尉升太尉之理，「尉」字必誤。

translations.literal: Comment: Bao Ju was already grand master—how could there be promoting from grand master to grand master; the character "master" must be wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Ju was already grand master; he could not be promoted from grand master to grand master—the title "master" must be mistaken.

sentences.zh: 以使持節鎮北將軍大都督秦州刺史万俟普撥為驃騎大將軍儀同三司 諸本「秦」作「泰」。

translations.literal: Commissioner with full powers, pacification-north general, commander-in-chief, governor of Qin province Moqi Pubo made rapid-as-lightning cavalry general, palace attendant of the third rank: in all editions "Qin" is written "Tai."
translations.idiomatic: Moqi Pubo, commissioner with full powers, pacification-north general, commander-in-chief, and governor of Qin province, was made rapid-as-lightning cavalry general and palace attendant of the third rank; all editions write Qin as Tai.

sentences.zh: 按万俟普撥是秦州刺史，歷見周書卷一文帝紀下永熙三年

translations.literal: Comment: Moqi Pubo was governor of Qin province, repeatedly seen in Zhoushu juan 1, Annals of Emperor Wen, part 2, Yongxi year 3
